cues.show: You with the guitar, the tune's tab on screen.
cues.say: This is a short tune to play on the guitar, one note at a time.

cues.show: Press the Play button, listen, then sing or hum the tune.
cues.say: Press the Play button below to hear it. Sing or hum along.

cues.show: Press the Play button, listen, then sing or hum the tune.
cues.say: A tune you can sing is much easier to play: your ear tells you when a note is wrong.

cues.show: Press notes, then neck, then tab, above the music.
cues.say: Above the tab you can pick how to read it: tab for strings and frets, notes for the note names, neck for dots on the guitar neck. Use the one that is easiest for you.

cues.show: Play along slowly, fretting hand visible, saying the fingers.
cues.say: Now play along. Under Tempo, the minus button slows it down.

cues.show: Play along slowly, fretting hand visible, saying the fingers.
cues.say: Keep your hand in one place and give each fret its own finger.

cues.show: Play it without the tool running.
cues.say: Practice until you can play the tune with the tool stopped, and you hear a wrong note at once.

cues.show: Sing along while playing. Start from another fret. Change the rhythm.
cues.say: Try things with it. Sing the tune while you play it.

cues.show: Sing along while playing. Start from another fret. Change the rhythm.
cues.say: Start the tune from another fret on the same string and work out the rest by ear.

cues.show: Sing along while playing. Start from another fret. Change the rhythm.
cues.say: Play it with long notes, then short ones. Then change the ending to one you like better.
